device_entry.name: 可编程交流电源
tags: 电子器件供电与台架测试
device_entry.description: 用于实验室中输出并调节交流电的电源设备，可设置电压、频率、电流限制以及输出开关，常用于供电测试、交流输入模拟和电源设备验证。
device_entry.description_en: A laboratory AC power source used to generate and control AC output. It supports setting voltage, frequency, current limit, and output on/off, and is commonly used for power input simulation, supply testing, and validation of AC-powered equipment.

schema.description: 读取或设置交流输出电压。

schema.description_en: Get or set the AC output frequency.

schema.description: 读取或设置交流输出开关状态。
schema.description_en: Get or set the AC output enable state.

schema.description: 读取或设置输出电流参数。
schema.description_en: Get or set the output current parameter.
